column1: # Black/Matrix AD - English script: Chapter 1 / Zero

column2: Don't start moving just 'cause you're awake!!
You've been asleep this whole time! Your body's gonna be in for a shock!
Seriously... You're a hell of a handful.
That day, when the huge $$落雷$$ struck... not that you remember it...
You went into the mountains for me to gather $$薬草$$.
Why didn't I go to a $$医者$$? Well...
It's complicated! There were reasons I couldn't go!!
Anyway, you went deep into the mountains and it looks like you got caught up in some kind of $$事故$$.
It was probably... a serious $$事故$$.
That day, after the rain stopped, when I finally could move again, I went into the mountains...
There, I saw the $$死体$$ of so many $$兵士達$$, lying in a circle around you...!!
When I saw you, $$血だらけ$$, barely breathing...
Never mind... The important thing is, you made it through all right!
Don't go pushing yourself, all right...!
